tool_args.rationale: The five paid rows match the spatiotemporal siphon-memory setting, but leave its five ODE parameters underdetermined. The extra fine trajectory batch is the listed relevant probe needed to reach the archive's minimum of eight rows and enable a numerically fitted, fresh-confirmable model.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the 5-parameter spatiotemporal siphon-memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five rows do not identify the five coupled parameters reliably; the archive requires at least eight.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the 5-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon adaptation law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed horizons are all short (0.38–0.52), so they do not distinguish the slow adaptation component.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a static siphon or simpler response law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The coupled-transient-lag signature and dependence on x_now and mem_conv argue against discarding memory dynamics.
It is explicitly irrelevant and cannot resolve the parameter-identifiability gap.
